findings.message: this step replaces the inferred predicate, which checks that idx_users_email is valid and ready, with one that does not mention indisvalid: an interrupted build leaves an invalid index, and a predicate that only finds it reports the wreckage as done. Drop the -- +mig satisfied: line and let it be inferred
findings.detail: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE on users, held for an index build; blocks no traffic
findings.fix:

findings.message: CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY blocks writes to users for the whole build; add CONCURRENTLY and mark the step notx
